transcript.text: Hi everyone. As you may know, yesterday a production build log exposed a credential-like string to authenticated engineering users for about 37 minutes. Initial triage found no confirmed misuse and no confirmed customer data access, but I own the incident response decision and need to finalize the containment and follow-up plan this afternoon. Per our incident-review routine, I need to check in with CI platform, customer success, and compliance before I can close this out. I'd like to go around and hear updates from each of those areas so we can wrap this up today.
